title: 大型弧形閘門安裝
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways
summary: 本課以以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門為主線，先用曲面水壓與水平力與曲面垂直分量界定水力與構造條件，再將吊索角度與張力、支臂長細與屈曲連結到同步行程與試運轉。算例為準靜態簡化構件，起吊與蓄水驗收仍須核准吊裝計畫、結構分析及現場量測。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning through Curved pressure and horizontal force and Vertical pressure component, then connects Sling angle and tension and Arm slenderness and buckling to Synchronized travel and commissioning. Examples idealize quasi-static components; lifting and impoundment acceptance require approved plans structural analysis and field measurements. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲面水壓與水平力」與「曲面垂直分量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Curved pressure and horizontal force" and "Vertical pressure component": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲面水壓與水平力」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curved pressure and horizontal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。水平分量可用垂直投影面計算；此便利不表示閘門沒有重量、摩擦或偏心力矩，安裝幾何與受力必須共同核對。 驗證時應核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置，並辨識以下失效情境：圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲面水壓與水平力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. Resolve the resultant into horizontal and vertical components. The horizontal component follows the vertical projection, but weight, friction and eccentricity still create moments that depend on installed geometry. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Curved pressure and horizontal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲面水壓與水平力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Curved pressure and horizontal force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲面水壓與水平力
knowledge.text: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。水平分量可用垂直投影面計算；此便利不表示閘門沒有重量、摩擦或偏心力矩，安裝幾何與受力必須共同核對。
knowledge.textEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. Resolve the resultant into horizontal and vertical components.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲面水壓與水平力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Curved pressure and horizontal force" is correct?
options: 理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩
弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。
曲面面積乘平均壓力必然就是垂直水壓力
optionsEn: Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment
Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion.
Curved area times mean pressure always equals vertical hydrostatic force
quiz.explanation: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲面水壓與水平力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curved pressure and horizontal force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「曲面水壓與水平力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Curved pressure and horizontal force", which statement holds?
options: 軸承反力不變就表示摩擦力矩永遠不變
面板總面積相同就保證局部彎曲完全相同
原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。
optionsEn: Constant bearing reaction guarantees constant friction torque
Equal total skin area guarantees identical local bending
Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲面水壓與水平力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Curved pressure and horizontal force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「曲面水壓與水平力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Curved pressure and horizontal force"?
options: 核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
總拉力除錨栓數就是每支錨栓的實際最大力
optionsEn: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Total tension divided by anchor count equals every anchor maximum
quiz.explanation: 核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曲面水壓與水平力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Curved pressure and horizontal force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. Diagnose it by the following check: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. Diagnose it by the following check: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「曲面水壓與水平力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Curved pressure and horizontal force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

曲面面積乘平均壓力必然就是垂直水壓力

A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model.
Curved area times mean pressure always equals vertical hydrostatic force

steps.title: 曲面垂直分量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vertical pressure component: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲面垂直分量」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vertical pressure component” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲面靜水力的垂直分量可由相應虛擬水體重量求得，方向取決於受壓面朝向與邊界。必須在自由體圖明示選用哪一水體，不能把曲面面積乘平均壓力當垂直力；此分量還會改變鉸支承反力與啟閉需求。 驗證時應以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較，並辨識以下失效情境：選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲面垂直分量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The vertical hydrostatic component corresponds to an appropriate imaginary water volume, with direction set by surface orientation. Show that volume explicitly in the free-body diagram; curved area times average pressure is not automatically a vertical force. This component also affects bearing reaction and operating demand. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vertical pressure component” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曲面面積乘平均壓力必然就是垂直水壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Curved area times mean pressure always equals vertical hydrostatic force" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲面垂直分量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Vertical pressure component”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The vertical hydrostatic component corresponds to an appropriate imaginary water volume, with direction set by surface orientation. Show that volume explicitly in the free-body diagram; curved area times average pressure is not automatically a vertical force.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：曲面面積乘平均壓力必然就是垂直水壓力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Curved area times mean pressure always equals vertical hydrostatic force Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲面垂直分量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vertical pressure component" is correct?
options: 曲面面積乘平均壓力必然就是垂直水壓力
兩鉸中心同高就保證三維軸線完全同軸
曲面靜水力的垂直分量可由相應虛擬水體重量求得，方向取決於受壓面朝向與邊界。
optionsEn: Curved area times mean pressure always equals vertical hydrostatic force
Equal trunnion-center elevations guarantee complete three-dimensional coaxiality
The vertical hydrostatic component corresponds to an appropriate imaginary water volume, with direction set by surface orientation.
quiz.explanation: 曲面靜水力的垂直分量可由相應虛擬水體重量求得，方向取決於受壓面朝向與邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The vertical hydrostatic component corresponds to an appropriate imaginary water volume, with direction set by surface orientation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲面垂直分量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vertical pressure component: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲面垂直分量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vertical pressure component” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「曲面垂直分量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vertical pressure component", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body。
兩根吊索不論角度都各承受總重的一半
理想歐拉屈曲力就是現場支臂可直接承受荷載
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body.
Two slings each carry half the weight regardless of angle
Ideal Euler load is the directly usable field capacity of the arm
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 曲面垂直分量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vertical pressure component: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲面垂直分量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vertical pressure component” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「曲面垂直分量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vertical pressure component"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較。
止水壓縮越多就必定越好且沒有代價
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration.
More seal compression is always better and has no adverse effect
quiz.explanation: 以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 曲面垂直分量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vertical pressure component: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曲面垂直分量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vertical pressure component” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力。診斷時應採取以下查核：以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. Diagnose it by the following check: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「曲面面積乘平均壓力必然就是垂直水壓力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Curved area times mean pressure always equals vertical hydrostatic force" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力。診斷時應採取以下查核：以剖面圖圈選虛擬水體並與壓力向量積分交叉比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. Diagnose it by the following check: Mark the imaginary volume on a section and compare it with pressure-vector integration. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「曲面垂直分量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vertical pressure component" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩鉸中心同高就保證三維軸線完全同軸
選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal trunnion-center elevations guarantee complete three-dimensional coaxiality
Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction.
quiz.explanation: 選錯虛擬水體或方向會錯估鉸支承垂直反力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Choosing the wrong volume or direction misstates vertical trunnion reaction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
